changes.summary: Clarified UI-Mate as a non-actuating action-proposal endpoint.
changes.details: The catalog and benchmark name now make the caller-owned screenshot loop and external human approval and execution boundary explicit.

changes.summary: Moved UI-Mate to the immutable vLLM 0.28.0 ARM64 release image.
changes.details: Pins the 0.28 scheduling and CUDA-graph bounds used by the other current Qwen-family recipes, while keeping the single-Spark 32K and one-sequence memory envelope.

changes.summary: Made all runtime compilation and model caches writable for the unprivileged service user.
changes.details: The entrypoint now creates its bounded cache directories on the mounted outputs volume before vLLM starts, avoiding first-launch failures caused by root-owned or missing cache paths.

changes.summary: Refreshed Tencent UI-Mate source provenance to d185dc9.
changes.details: The upstream change publishes OSWorkerBench and README links only; the three vendored serving-harness files remain byte-identical to the prior revision.

changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Initial UI-Mate 27B BF16 single-Spark Candidate with Tencent's official computer-use harness.
changes.details: Pins the exact Tencent checkpoint and source revision, directly vendors the official prompt/parser/action behavior, and adapts Tencent's TP2 vLLM launch to a bounded TP1 32K single-Spark profile pending physical acceptance.
